name: mirage
text: Change made, compiles, not released yet. I can't see your phone, so this is my best fix: when you return, the app was starting every GitHub sync and redrawing everything while its first frame was still drawing, which can show as blur. It now waits 0.6 s for the screen to settle first. It ships with the next release. If it is still blurry after that, tell me which tab you were on.
